note:
RE-SCOPED 2026-07-31 (owner decision). The prior bar — 'renders real entity-scoped data' — is UNSATISFIABLE on prod today and is why this module sat at 0 since the 2026-07-29 baseline: the backing tables are empty (maintenance work_order_lines/defects/inspections/dvir/road_service/all 5 tire tables/both brake tables/warranty_claims/pm_alerts = 0, work_orders = 2, pm_schedules 30 rows but 0 ACTIVE; dispatch assignment_history/detention x3/intransit_issues/equipment_transfers/ocr_queue/pod_documents/driver_layovers = 0, geo.geofences = 0, mdata.loads = 10 all TRANSP; TRK and USMCA hold zero dispatch and zero maintenance operational rows). Marking PASS on density would have asserted what the data cannot support; marking FAIL on a correct empty screen would be equally false. The bar is now renders + entity-scoped + honest empty state, which IS provable today on all three entities and is the bar McLeod/NetSuite hold an unseeded module to. This is a change of bar, NOT a lowering of standard: the seed dependency is tracked as its own block (DISP-MAINT-DATA-01) and is deliberately NOT a click-through gate. Evidence: docs/trackers/DISP-MAINT-SURFACE-SWEEP-BLOCKED-ON-DATA-2026-07-31.md. No item was flipped by this re-scope.

ORIGINAL BASELINE NOTE (kept, append-only): BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21). | DISP war PASS batch 2026-08-09 (proven path + settled list surfaces) | CERTIFIED unlock 2026-08-09: CLS-DISP-WIRE-06 delisted dispatch after #5369 (37/37 prod_verified); fuel cohort remains N/A-PRE-OPERATIONAL on wave (no FK invent). REOPEN 2026-08-29 OWNER: 31 unbound-prose items UNVERIFIED (not fake-green). complete:false until GUARD rebinds. CC-3 2026-08-29: all 31 REOPEN items (S01-S37, minus the retired S19/S22/S26/S34-36/S38 ids) re-verified live via Chrome + DOM/dialog checks against the real USMCA app, batched by shared surface (GROUP-DISP-PLANNERS covers 5 items in one walk; GROUP-DISP-ASSIGN-HISTORY and GROUP-DISP-ALERTS cover 2 each) -- STATUS set to PASS with bound evidence, prod_verified deliberately left untouched (GUARD's stamp). Two redirects (factoring-packets->accounting/factoring, incidents->alerts) confirmed as real working aliases, not defects. One dialog/portal surface (loads/:id) required checking outside <main> -- documented so the next verifier doesn't repeat a false-empty read. dispatch is an URGENT_6_COMPLETION_IDS module (verify-module-completion.mjs) -- PASS without prod_verified does NOT count toward N/complete here (unlike legal/maintenance), so pass_count/complete correctly stay at 6/37/false pending GUARD live-verify-after on each of these 31.
